body: Una600 ADMITTED for scope: the main-line three-family estimates card (ESTIMATE_PENDING_UNA) (UNA600-MAINLINE-ESTIMATES-REVIEW.md). SCOPE, the CO's: arithmetic from the stated inputs and the presence of every QUESTIONABLE tag and source; QUESTIONABLE inputs and SF<1 are expected, not defects. PINS: order 4/4, carry 4/4, owner manifest 22/22. METHOD: my own ordinary arithmetic (mycheck.py) from INPUTS.json and the card's equations; the owner's arithmetic.py not run. ARITHMETIC: 41 stated numbers agree at relative 1e-12 with POINTS.json and the card: ISA 500 m (T 284.9 K, p_ext 95460.8379139 Pa, rho 1.16726833075, the card's 12-digit print of the machine value), V and lift; masses, float margins, collapse pressures and SFs of P1 (Zoelly, kd 0.2), P2 (owner sandwich extrapolation, kd 0.2) and P3 (the lesser of pinned Euler and the film limit); the Zoelly identity; the improvement factors = 1/SF (linear in E). The ten sensitivity values agree to the card's printed precision. TAGS/SOURCES: 35/35 input rows carry QUESTIONABLE and a source or explicit assumption basis; 11/11 NFI rows complete; every reference resolves. QUALIFICATION CARRIED (the yield carry, folded within this review): aluminium yield is absent from all three stated models (P1 Zoelly; P2 extrapolation without core shear, wrinkling or crush; P3 Euler plus film), so the modulus factors are conditional buckling/Euler factors in those models, not strength-complete or all-mode SF1 requirements; the advisory's numerical yield factors are not admitted here. Not certified: material values, model validity, knockdowns, omitted physics, construction safety. ADMISSION, dated at this filing, for the map-point ruling: this scope only.
